notes.text: Recovered input recorder and struct. Best 97.5% before final variants; only initial pointer/limit/load ordering differs. Full notes in workspace analysis/input-variants.json. Do not spend unbounded compiles.

Traced 030042F0+4 -> 03003F84 -> player +A4. Native controls/vector phase in src/movement.c passes 36864 ROM differential cases through 08006A3E (one player, before collision/entity sync). Full function not matched. Fields: +24 yaw velocity, +B0 forward speed, +B4 strafe, +B8 heading, +BA move heading, +BC flags, +C2 B-held ticks, +20 impulse speed, +DC impulse heading, +0C/+10 vector. Original impulse path overwrites strafe temporaries with scaled impulse then adds unscaled impulse unit vector; verified, preserve. Remaining full-function dependencies: multiplayer push 0658A..06614; 05E04/05E28 entity sync; 04BDC horizontal movement/collision; 04CE0 vertical physics.

Native sine/cosine passes every 65536 heading against original in tests/test_movement_rom.py. Lookup: 16-bit heading four quadrants; 16384 u16 quarter-wave samples at 0801C930; exact axes return +/-65536. Matching best 82.0%, score1940, 108 instructions each; best source recovered/sincos.c. Const/nonconst arrays let agbcc merge switch tails; volatile prevents merging and yields correct count, remaining register allocation differs. 20 bounded compile trials done; asm register declarations rejected by this compiler. Do not count as exact. Native direction lookup also validated: table08024930, 32769 u16 values; input signed16 axes.

Entire vertical behavior ported in src/physics.c::ssa_vertical_step and verified in 22471 ROM cases with no mocked calls. Candidate recovered/vertical_step.c best69.2%, score4425, not exact (8 compiler trials). +08 Z16.16, +14 VZ, +2C height16.16, +30 flags(10 player,100 no gravity), +43 signed hover offset, +54 player index, +70/+72 signed ceiling/floor. Player +BC bit20 set from pre-integration wholeZ==floor; +D0/+D4 eye adjustment deliberately subtracts unshifted floor-wholeZ. Native jump is separate extension, not matching behavior. See analysis/physics.md.

Full camera behavioral port in src/physics.c::ssa_camera_step verified in 9096 original-ROM cases; only sound08D5C hooked as event recorder. Original trig and fixed multiply executed. Preserved mixed-unit camera clamp and step-adjust quirks. Native jump scenario verifies eye Z follows body through full flight/landing. See analysis/physics.md and tests/test_physics_rom.py.

Bounded BSP-side matching pass stopped at 20 total attempts (16 new variants, including two C89 declaration-order compile errors). Best remains score 75, 98.6%, all 56 instructions present. Candidate recovered/bsp_side.c preserves the goto return shape needed for matching control flow. Remaining differences are y/dx register allocation (target y=r5, dx=r3; candidate swapped), and the final product evaluation order. Signedness changes, declaration order, product temporaries, comparator reversal, destructive multiplication and point high-halfword load expressions did not improve score. Destructive delta products uniquely get all initial registers right but omit the two target product-copy instructions; investigate lifetimes of product temporaries next. Full new diffs saved in analysis/bsp-match-attempts.json. Native behavior is being validated separately; do not count this near-match as exact.
